reviews.t: A lovely community brought together by a young, vibrant pastor with God in his heart & mind.

I have never been inside the church, but they have a very welcoming Open Table on wednesday, afternoons for the community to have a hot meal. Very friendly staff. Good place to do volunteering if you are interested.

Beautiful Church. Great for Children and families. Clean and clean restrooms. Wheelchair accessible. Great congregation. Great outreach to the community with the Church having several types of functions 7 days a week or evenings. I LOVE being a member of a Church Family such as this. It makes a person feel Loved, Wanted and a Part of Something Huge.
TRUE CHRISTIAN FELLOWSHIP. They made our First visit feel like we were old friends returning for a visit
They have an open table. Free food if you're hungry.
My mom always hear time bells 🔔🔔🔔 at church. …
